title: Za'atar Flatbreads with Olive Oil, Cucumber, Tomato and Mint
summary: Soft, chewy flatbreads spread with a fragrant za'atar and olive oil paste and baked on hot trays until golden at the edges. Served warm, folded around cucumber, tomato and fresh mint.
equipment: clean tea towel or cling film

ingredients.item: plain or bread flour, plus extra for dusting
fine sea salt or table salt
za'atar blend (dried thyme, sumac and sesame), salt-free or low-salt

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Combine the flour, sugar and salt in the bowl, then add the 3 tbsp oil, the yeast and the 320ml water and work everything together with your hand until a soft, slightly sticky dough forms. Add 1-2 tbsp more water if it feels dry. A soft dough gives tender, chewy flatbreads.

steps.title: Knead and rise
steps.text: Rest the dough for 5 minutes, then knead for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Rub with a little oil, cover and leave for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until doubled. The short rest before kneading lets the flour hydrate, so the dough smooths out faster.

steps.title: Mix the topping
steps.text: Stir the za'atar into the 120ml oil to make a loose paste. The oil carries the flavour of the thyme, sumac and sesame and keeps the topping from drying out in the hot oven.

steps.title: Divide and rest
steps.text: Cut the dough into 6 equal pieces of about 140g, roll them into balls and set them on an oiled tray. Cover and leave for 30 minutes, until nearly doubled. Resting relaxes the gluten so the balls press out thinly without springing back.

steps.title: Heat the trays
steps.text: Heat the oven to 250°C (fan 230°C), or its maximum, with both lightly oiled trays inside, for 15 minutes. Hot trays crisp the bases from the moment the dough lands on them.

steps.title: Shape and top
steps.text: On a floured sheet of baking paper, press a ball out with your fingertips into a thin 20cm round. Spread one-sixth of the za'atar oil over it, leaving a narrow border, and press the topping in with the back of a spoon. Pressing it in keeps the bread flat rather than puffing up like a pitta.

steps.title: Bake in batches
steps.text: Slide the paper with 2-3 rounds onto a hot tray and bake for 6-8 minutes, until golden at the edges and the topping is bubbling. Shape the next batch while each one bakes. Serve warm, folded around cucumber, tomato and mint.

tips: A common mistake is spreading the za'atar oil right to the edge, where it can burn; leave a narrow border.
Choose a salt-free or low-salt za'atar, as some blends are very salty.
Press the dough out with your fingertips rather than a rolling pin to keep a soft, dimpled texture.
Cool the baked flatbreads on a wire rack so the bases stay crisp.
storage: Cool within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days, or freeze. Warm through in a hot oven before serving.
